evidence_source: the record's focal form and synthesis

sections.heading: A candidate {{entity_noun}} qualifies only if ALL of these conditions hold for it, without tripping any of the guards below:

rules.text: The record says something substantive about the candidate {{entity_noun}} — describing an activity, arrangement, or dealing that involves it — rather than only naming it, listing it, or mentioning it in passing. Which party is involved is not this condition's subject; [SCR-2] decides that.

It is the manufacturer itself that {{entity_relationships.third_person}} the candidate {{entity_noun}} — not a customer, supplier, distributor, or other third party that the manufacturer merely relates to.

children.text: The manufacturer in question is NAMED at the top of the request; records may refer to it by that name, as "the manufacturer", or by any of its brands. Other companies may appear by name or by their standing. A brand, trade name, former name, division, plant, or business unit of the manufacturer IS the manufacturer itself. A statement about the manufacturer's parent company or a sister brand counts as one about the manufacturer itself, and does not fail this condition merely for being attributed to them — unless the record shows the activity belongs to that company alone and not to the manufacturer.

Where the work is physically done does not decide this. A plant the manufacturer owns outright, a plant it part-owns, and a partner plant producing to its direction are all the manufacturer itself, and the record does not have to say which. What still fails this condition is a candidate {{entity_noun}} that another party {{entity_relationships.third_person}} as its own business rather than for the manufacturer.

sections.heading: A candidate {{entity_noun}} is ruled out if ANY of these guards is violated by it. Ruling out one candidate has no bearing on the record's other candidates:

rules.text: The manufacturer's involvement in the candidate {{entity_noun}} is only aspirational, hoped-for, planned, or discontinued, rather than current and actual.
